scoring_justification: Checker recomputes n_min from the same Debye-approximation formulas with α=10, δ=0.01 and tolerances account for numerical integration differences.

required.n_min_curve: array of objects with T_ratio (float) and n_min (float)
required.material_estimates: array of objects with material (string), T (float), a0_angstrom (float), theta (float), n_min (float), l_min_um (float)

outputs.description: Scored result: minimal group size curve and material length-scale estimates. The checker recomputes the expected n_min from the same equations and parameters, then compares the submitted values against the recomputed reference within per-check tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The target_policy is reference_match because the agent submits computed quantities, and the checker independently recomputes the expected reference values from the same analytical formulas and parameters (no hidden holdout). Equality is not required; tolerances based on expected numerical integration differences are applied.

steps.notes: Recompute n_min curve and material estimates, check asymptotics and shape.
